Final RunPlan and unified FitCache qualification — 2026-10-19

Source: vignettes/articles/contributor-tools-components-fits-qualification.Rmd
contributor-tools-components-fits-qualification.Rmd

Contributing · Object model · Discovery walkthrough · Object fields

Supporting record: claims apply to the revisions and environments named below; this page does not qualify a later candidate.

Implementation: e545b0891292ba82399271ec35c2e1f6818d0cbe, following the separate typed-RunPlan checkpoint e86eb48. The working saved schema remains 3, with explicit adapters for old list plans and physical response-only cache layouts. Exact current field tables are generated from the actual S4 class definitions.

Check Terminal result
R CMD build . Passed, including vignette generation.
R CMD check --no-manual --no-build-vignettes Status: OK, including examples, installed tests and vignette R code.
Final installed-package tests 5,069 passed; 0 failures, warnings or skips.

Environment: R 4.6.0, macOS arm64, ondisc 1.2.0. The exact final archive checksum, 158 source-file comparisons, terminal check logs, test output and JSON totals are in validation/. The source-suite and parity checkpoint was frozen before one nonnumerical namespace qualification of the RunPlan slot setter. Its original hashes are preserved. The rebuilt archive and final installed-package suite cover the exact final source. There are no native-source changes.

The final check does not include manual PDF generation or rebuilding vignette outputs during check; the build generated them and check executed their R code. BiocCheck’s R-version recommendation and interactive bioc-help check were disabled. The warning concerns the existing lack of Bioconductor infrastructure dependencies. Notes concern console output, condition messages, nonlocal assignment, function length, line width and indentation; these are not claimed resolved.

The numerical evidence distinguishes equal-budget reference comparisons from the old calibration-budget overwrite. New cache tests also count actual fitting calls: warm runs perform no perturbation refits while still generating full CRT banks. Real low-MOI NT fixtures exercise both shared and per-entry incompatible-context misses. Other tests cover independent family invalidation, compact entries, single-fit unsupported-model fallback, legitimate warnings, transactional failure, saved cache/plan migration and serialization.

Eugenio Mattei’s PR #233 was inspected by title, author, pinned diff, body and inline review. Its compact exact reconstruction, independent invalidation, calibration bypass and fresh draws were adopted. Current ownership uses one FitCache with shared context and per-group input hashes, without repeated NT indices. Aliased/nonfinite or inexact fits use their original probabilities and remain uncached. Actual-fit warnings are retained as diagnostics and are not replayed on warm hits. The RunPlan assessment records why S4 is a reasonable consistency choice rather than an automatic correctness or immutability improvement.

Qualification is local to the recorded platform/runtime. It establishes no large-screen speed or memory benchmark, cross-platform arithmetic portability, all-historical-object guarantee or Nextflow compatibility. Active backing files remain immutable by contract; no external-tamper monitoring was added. No push, PR publication, merge or release was performed. The later book-grounded audit is outside this completed implementation scope.
